# NEW 2026-11-22 v15.0 Global Kernel, Native UX, Theme Expansion & 1337 Challenge Presets. Generated by gen_v150_kernel_ux.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Founds one standard expansion theme in area:$area$ if BYZ owns non-historical land
# there, no theme occupies the area yet, and Pillars Authority >= $cost$.
oe_v150_found_area_theme = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { var:oe_pillars_authority >= $cost$ }
			area:$area$ = {
				any_location_in_area = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner ?= c:BYZ
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
				}
				NOT = { any_location_in_area = { oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes } }
			}
		}
		area:$area$ = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_location_in_area = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner ?= c:BYZ
						is_province_capital = yes
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
					}
				}
				random_location_in_area = {
					limit = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner ?= c:BYZ
						is_province_capital = yes
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
					}
					save_scope_as = oe_theme_seat
				}
			}
			else = {
				random_location_in_area = {
					limit = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner ?= c:BYZ
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
					}
					save_scope_as = oe_theme_seat
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_theme_seat }
			international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -$cost$ }
			}
			scope:oe_theme_seat = {
				create_building_country_in_location = {
					religion = religion:orthodox
					culture = culture:oe_roman_noble_culture
					subject_type = subject_type:oe_empire_theme
					overlord = c:BYZ
					reforms = { oe_byz_theme_system_subject }
					hidden_effect = {
						change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
						change_heir_selection = heir_selection:oe_rome_province_elect
					}
					save_scope_as = target_building_country
				}
				construct_building = {
					building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system_noble
					owner = scope:target_building_country
					cost_multiplier = 0
					cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
				}
			}
			scope:target_building_country = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = ruler }
					ruler = { add_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI }
				}
			}
			scope:oe_theme_seat = { save_scope_as = oe_theme_name_seat }
			scope:target_building_country = { oe_theme_apply_name = yes }
			international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
				add_country_to_international_organization = scope:target_building_country
				international_organization_add_special_status = {
					type = special_status:oe_pillars_theme
					country = scope:target_building_country
				}
			}
			area:$area$ = {
				every_location_in_area = {
					limit = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner ?= c:BYZ
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
					}
					construct_building = {
						building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system
						owner = scope:target_building_country
						cost_multiplier = 0
						cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
					}
				}
			}
			scope:oe_theme_seat = {
				while = {
					count = 3
					create_sub_unit_with_owner = {
						type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_I
						owner = scope:target_building_country
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_coastal = yes }
					while = {
						count = 6
						create_sub_unit_with_owner = {
							type = n_cog
							owner = scope:target_building_country
						}
					}
				}
			}
			scope:target_building_country = {
				set_gold = 300
				add_manpower = 3
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_named }
					oe_theme_admin_init = yes
				}
			}
			c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_theme_found_exp_count add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

# BYZ scope. Batch-founds eligible Italian/Latin themes across unoccupied areas in italy_region.
oe_v150_found_italy_expansion_themes = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_ir_italian_theme_done
			oe_italian_theme_creation_unlocked = yes
		}
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				region = region:italy_region
				is_province_capital = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { var:oe_pillars_authority >= $cost$ }
					area = { NOT = { any_location_in_area = { oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes } } }
				}
				save_scope_as = oe_it_theme_capital
				province = { save_scope_as = target }
				international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
					change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -$cost$ }
					save_scope_as = oe_pillars_org
				}
				if = {
					limit = { c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_theme_italian_unlocked } }
					oe_it_theme_create_offices = {
						subject_type = oe_empire_theme_italian
						reform = oe_byz_theme_italian_subject
						seat = oe_byz_theme_italian_seat
						post = oe_byz_theme_italian_post
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_theme_latin_unlocked } }
					oe_it_theme_create_offices = {
						subject_type = oe_empire_theme_latin
						reform = oe_byz_theme_latin_subject
						seat = oe_byz_theme_latin_seat
						post = oe_byz_theme_latin_post
					}
					scope:oe_it_theme_country = { add_manpower = 3 }
					scope:oe_it_theme_capital = {
						oe_it_theme_create_three_current_age_infantry = { owner = scope:oe_it_theme_country }
					}
				}
				scope:oe_it_theme_country = { set_gold = 300 }
				international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
					add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_it_theme_country
				}
				scope:oe_it_theme_country = { oe_pillars_classify_member_effect = yes }
				c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_theme_found_exp_count add = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# BYZ scope. Tier-2 One-Click Founding across all unlocked expansion zones (Italy / Eastern / Austrian / Swiss).
# Deducts $cost$ Authority per theme and stops cleanly whenever Authority runs out.
oe_v150_theme_found_expansion_all = {
	# 1. Italian Expansion Zone (italy_region)
	oe_v150_found_italy_expansion_themes = { cost = $cost$ }

	# 2. Eastern Expansion Zone (Jazira, Iraq Arabi, Levant)
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_create_eastern_themes_done }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = jazira_area cost = $cost$ }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = iraq_arabi_area cost = $cost$ }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = levant_area cost = $cost$ }
	}

	# 3. Austrian Expansion Zone (7 Danubian & Alpine areas)
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_create_austrian_themes_done }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = transdanubia_area cost = $cost$ }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = upper_austria_area cost = $cost$ }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = austria_area cost = $cost$ }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = styria_area cost = $cost$ }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = salzburg_area cost = $cost$ }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = carinthia_area cost = $cost$ }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = tirol_area cost = $cost$ }
	}

	# 4. Swiss Expansion Zone (3 Helvetic areas)
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_create_swiss_themes_done }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = eastern_switzerland_area cost = $cost$ }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = central_switzerland_area cost = $cost$ }
		oe_v150_found_area_theme = { area = western_switzerland_area cost = $cost$ }
	}
}
